title: Offline Makes Online Better: Calibrated Cache Compression for Video Generation
title_zh: 离线让在线更好：面向视频生成的校准缓存压缩

paragraphs.en: 总结：CALM通过离线校准构建层级-注意力头风险图，在推理时用动态规划分配合并比例，显著提升自回归视频生成的缓存压缩效果。 Token merging is an effective approach to reducing KV-cache memory consumption in autoregressive video generation by clustering temporally redundant tokens and retaining only a small set of representatives. Existing methods, however, typically apply a uniform merging ratio across all attention layers and heads. We observe that different layers and heads exhibit substantially different yet jointly correlated sensitivities to token merging, and that these sensitivity patterns remain consistent across prompts. Based on this observation, we introduce CALM, a Calibrated Allocation for Layer-Head Merging that uses offline calibration to improve online cache compression. Exhaustively evaluating all possible layer-head allocations is prohibitively expensive. To enable efficient calibration, we show that attention-output error strongly correlates with end-to-end video quality and can therefore serve as a lightweight proxy for allocation risk assessment. We evaluate different allocation strategies using this proxy and construct a fixed layer-head risk map offline. Given a cache budget at inference time, CALM uses dynamic programming to determine the best allocation of merging ratios. Experiments across three different autoregressive video models demonstrate that CALM consistently outperforms uniform token merging under the same memory budget, by reducing the LPIPS to original videos by around 21% with higher video-quality scores.
paragraphs.zh: 总结：CALM 通过离线校准构建层级-注意力头风险图，在推理时用动态规划分配合并比例，显著提升自回归视频生成的缓存压缩效果。Token merging 是一种有效降低自回归视频生成中 KV 缓存内存消耗的方法，它通过聚类时间上冗余的 token，仅保留一小组代表性 token。 然而，现有方法通常在所有注意力层和注意力头上采用统一的合并比例。 我们观察到，不同的层和注意力头对 token merging 表现出显著不同但相互关联的敏感性，并且这些敏感性模式在不同提示词之间保持一致。 基于这一观察，我们提出了 CALM，一种用于层级-注意力头合并的校准式分配方法，它利用离线校准来改进在线缓存压缩。 穷举评估所有可能的层-注意力头分配方案的代价高得令人望而却步。 为了实现高效校准，我们证明注意力输出误差与端到端视频质量强相关，因此可以作为分配风险评估的轻量级代理指标。 我们使用该代理指标评估不同的分配策略，并离线构建一个固定的层-注意力头风险图。 在推理时给定缓存预算后，CALM 使用动态规划来确定合并比例的最优分配。 在三个不同自回归视频模型上的实验表明，在相同内存预算下，CALM 始终优于统一的 token merging，将相对于原始视频的 LPIPS 降低了约 21%，同时获得了更高的视频质量分数。
